messages.speaker: them
messages.text: 🚴 found it — a loop over the reservoir pass, down into the gorge road, back over the ridge. 62km, 900m up. saturday looks dry!!

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: 900?? my legs are still not speaking to me after last time

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: 900 is a friendly 900 — one grind, then you coast the whole descent 🚵

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: you say that every single time

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: and i'm always right 🙂 when do you want wheels rolling? i'd say 7:00 to beat the campervans

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: seven is brutal but fine. who's actually in?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: me, you, and mara says probably — is tomas still up for the long version or is the knee casting a veto?

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: haven't heard from him since the dam. does the high route have water anywhere after that?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: one tap at km 18 and a spring past the gorge — you carrying two bottles anyway?

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: two bottles and snacks, always

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: smart. i'm fitting the wide tyres tonight, that ridge gravel got sketchy last autumn 🛠️

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: same, and i'll bring the pump with the broken gauge

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: 😂 that pump has lied to us twice. meet at the bakery 7:15, bread first, suffering after

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: that's the spirit. sharing the route file to the group chat now

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: ☔ well, saturday's gone — steady rain till the afternoon. do we write the week off, or move to the shaded valley loop next saturday?

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: valley loop next saturday. i'm not riding in that

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: mara's driving her sister to the airport that morning, so she's free after. i'd rather eat rain than do a boring valley, but i will survive 🌬️

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: the valley has that bakery with the plum pastry

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: sold. valley loop, next saturday, 10am, no suffering — pastries as the training goal 🥐

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: ten is civilised. what do we do about tomas?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: knee's still grumbling — should we plan the dam walk for him or let him bail on his own terms?

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: plan the walk. he grumbles but he loves it

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: he'll take 400 photos of the same duck either way, tradition 😄

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: i'll dig out the bike lights anyway, days are getting shorter

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: good call. i'll check the brake pads tonight and swap the back wheel if it's squared off 🔧

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: and pump it properly this time, not with the lying pump

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: the lying pump stays home forever. i bought the little digital one in june 🎉

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: packing check for tomorrow!! layers for 12 degrees at the start, warm at the top. i've got the flask, the salt tablets and a spare tube — you take the pump, mara has the snacks gig

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: snacks gig accepted. meeting point still the bakery?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: yes, wheels roll at 10 — does 9:50 arrival work for you?

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: 9:45 for me, bike already loaded

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: over-prepared as usual 😄 route file is shared — the tricky bit is the gravel by the fish farm, walk it if it's loose, no shoulder gambles

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: walking it, my shoulder thanks you in advance

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: we finish at the lake around 3, where tomas will be waiting, insufferably smug about his duck census 🦆

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: ha, classic. i'm off to sleep, big day

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: night!! golden saturday incoming 🌅

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: forecast still holding for tomorrow?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: rain stays east of the ridge until sunday. mara just wrote 'do not let them make me climb anything dangerous' — are we outnumbered or what 😂

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: democracy. valley loop stands

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: valley loop forever. the toilet stop at the dam café is in the route file, so nobody can heroically skip it

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: heroic skipping cancelled then

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: exactly. last thing before i sleep — do you have mara's new number? she never answers the old one 📱
